errors.description: The displayed identity for Hᵀ is false for the general distinct nodes allowed by the theorem: its right-hand side has superdiagonal entries c₁,…,cₙ, whereas Hᵀ has entries 1,…,n. The next displayed computation uses Dₙ instead of Cₙ, which does give the required entries.

errors.location: Lemma 2.1, i≠j branch of the displayed identity in Crop 7
errors.description: The product on the right-hand side omits only k=j, but the derivative on the left requires omitting both k=i and k=j. The supplied proof later gives the latter, correct product.
errors.evidence: Take n=1, c₀=0, c₁=2, i=0, j=1. The left side is ψ′(c₁)=1; the displayed right side ∏_{k≠j}(c₁−cₖ)=2. The proof following equation (2.7) instead gives ∏_{k≠i,j}(c_j−c_k)=1.

errors.location: Introduction statement identifying the BIM inverse with Wₙᵀ; Section 2.2 displayed formula for N
errors.description: The two supplied claims for the BIM inverse disagree: the introduction identifies it as Wₙᵀ for cᵢ=i, while the later expression for N adds Dₙ⁻¹ to a term that equals Wₙᵀ.
errors.evidence: For n=1, c₀=0, c₁=1, Wₙᵀ=[1]. The displayed formula gives N=[1·(1·1·1·1)+1]=[2], so N≠Wₙᵀ.
